module.title: OSIRIS
module.expensive_path: The coupled PIC iteration advances particle phase-space state, deposits charge-conserving currents, updates electromagnetic fields, exchanges guard cells across MPI domains, and writes diagnostics; particle push and deposition scale with particle count while field updates and communication scale with grid size and decomposition.
module.rationale: OSIRIS has one configure/Make build, one dimension-specific program entry point, one coupled simulation state, and one family of input decks. Particle, current, field, collision, diagnostic, restart, and load-balancing directories are internal algorithm stages rather than independently executable packages with separate scientific input/output contracts and official suites, so the whole-codebase default is the coherent module boundary.
hazards: A native build requires an external Fortran compiler, MPI wrappers, and HDF5 Fortran libraries; they were unavailable on the investigation host.

Particle initialization and some physics models use pseudorandom generators; fixed seeds are available, but results can vary with MPI decomposition unless decomposition-independent RNG behavior is enabled.
The repository supplies official example decks but no checked-in numerical golden outputs or standalone regression harness.
Particle storage order, MPI rank layout, timings, and metadata are not stable scientific identities and must not be compared positionally in later checks.

approval.human_ref: single-module default: the whole codebase is one module; no human decision at STOP 1, the cut is read in the source PR body at STOP 2
